findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §10 Market hours 09:30–16:00 ET; Timezone always America/New_York — never UTC
findings.reason: Session window is evaluated in UTC, so the LIMIT price monitor runs 05:30–12:00 ET (EDT) and is idle for most of the real session.
Tests only pick instants that pass under both UTC and ET, so they do not detect the timezone defect (e.g. 19:00Z / 15:00 ET would be wrongly closed).

findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §7 Kafka Rules (retry 3x with backoff, then {topic}.DLT)
findings.reason: Swallowing all exceptions in the listener bypasses the DefaultErrorHandler, so failed executions are never retried or sent to order.execution.requested.DLT and are silently lost.
New skip/validation logic in the consumer has no unit tests.

findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §13a BigDecimal — scale for money setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
findings.reason: SELL proceeds are truncated with deprecated ROUND_DOWN while BUY uses HALF_UP, systematically short-changing clients and violating the mandated money rounding.

findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §10 NEVER skip unit tests for business logic / §15
findings.reason: Only the BUY commission path is tested; the new SELL net-proceeds logic is untested.

findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §6 Level 2 check #12 (self trade at crossing price)
findings.reason: Crossing comparison is inverted vs. the replaced logic (BUY crosses when resting sell limit <= buy limit), so genuine self-trades pass and non-crossing orders are flagged.
Extracted Level 2 validation component has no unit tests, which would have caught the inversion.

findings.rule: CLAUDE.md §14 Role matrix (TRADER: View All Orders = No)
findings.reason: Blotter returns every order across all clients with no role/ownership scoping, and the filter admits TRADER on GET /api/v1/orders/**.
FILLED/PARTIALLY_FILLED orders are reported with filledQuantity=0 and avgFillPrice=null, publishing incorrect execution state.
Unbounded, unpaginated full-table fetch bypasses MAX_PAGE_SIZE; also no tests for the new endpoint.
